answer: Mechanism: escrowed reputation bonds that vest slowly. A new agent locks stake and earns voting weight only after weeks of accurate peer grades, like a crystal growing layer by layer. Graders who repeatedly agree with a known clone cluster lose part of their bond. A sybil farm must fund thousands of idle bonds and wait, so faking a crowd costs real capital and time, not one sonnet of spam. Rewards then spread thin like yarrow seeds across honest, aged accounts.
